title: Add Articles/Blog publishing flow so submitted posts can be published and visible

requirements.text: Add an Articles/Blog section in the frontend so visitors can browse published articles and open a full article detail page, using the existing published story feed and detail functionality.

quotes: Issue is I am unable to publish I have shared article but cannot see ...

acceptanceCriteria: The app has a clearly labeled "Articles" entry in the primary navigation.
The Articles page lists published items returned by the existing published-content API and shows an empty state when none exist.
Clicking an article opens a detail page that renders the full content.
Existing routes for current story pages continue to work (no broken links).

requirements.text: Implement a "My Submissions" page for authenticated users to see articles they have submitted and whether each is Pending (not yet published) or Published, so submitters can verify their content was received even before moderation/publishing.

quotes: Issue is I am unable to publish I have shared article but cannot see ...

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores the submitter Principal for each new submission.
Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s submissions with a status field (Pending/Published).
Frontend provides a "My Submissions" page that requires login and shows a clear login prompt if the user is not authenticated.
After submitting an article while logged in, the new submission appears in "My Submissions" with status Pending without needing a page refresh.
When an admin publishes a submission, its status changes to Published in "My Submissions" and it becomes visible on the public Articles page.

requirements.text: Update the submission confirmation UI to clearly explain that submitted articles are not publicly visible until published, and provide a direct link to "My Submissions" (for logged-in users) so the user can immediately confirm the submission is recorded.

quotes: Issue is I am unable to publish I have shared article but cannot see ...

acceptanceCriteria: The post-submit success message explicitly states that the article will not appear publicly until it is published.
The success screen includes a button/link to "My Submissions" when the user is logged in (and a login call-to-action if not logged in).
The wording is in English and matches the site’s tone (no placeholder text).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Do not implement email notifications to authorsanakhan@gmail.com or any outbound email feature (not supported in this environment).
Do not add third-party auth providers; only Internet Identity is allowed.
